description: Retrieve reusable task memories before starting substantive coding work. Use this at the beginning of implementation, debugging, migration, configuration, investigation, refactor, or optimization tasks to load project-scoped memories first and optional global lessons second. Use mode="debug" when the user reports an error, failing command, regression, or incident; include error_signatures and related_files when available. Use search_knowledge instead for ad hoc semantic note search that is not tied to the current task. This tool is read-only and returns ranked memories plus optional related-note context without writing anything.

mode.description: Use task for normal work and debug when the task starts from an error, failing test, or incident.

options.description: Optional limits and relation expansion controls for recall results.

global_limit.description: Maximum number of cross-project/global lessons to append after project memories.

include_relations.description: Whether to include related-note context for returned memories.

project_limit.description: Maximum number of project-scoped memories to return first.

task.description: Current task context used to retrieve relevant project and global memories.

branch.description: Current VCS branch when relevant to the task.

cwd.description: Current working directory of the agent session.

error_signatures.description: Concrete errors, stack traces, failing commands, or symptoms. Most useful with debug tasks.

files_touched.description: Files already touched or expected to be touched; improves project memory matching.

goal.description: Plain-language task goal or user request. Include enough context to retrieve relevant memories.

project_dir.description: Absolute project directory when known; helps ChatCrystal match memories to the right local workspace.

project_key.description: Stable project identifier used to prioritize project-scoped memories, such as a repository or workspace key.

related_files.description: Additional files related to the task but not necessarily modified.

source_agent.description: AI coding tool or agent that is calling ChatCrystal; use unknown when unsure.

task_kind.description: Kind of work being performed. Use debug for failures; choose the closest non-debug category for planned work.

name: recall_for_task
